## Scientific Review Record

# GOHIF Scientific Review Record

ID: SRR-FC-001

Title:
Food Chain Domain Scientific Review

Status:
Frozen

Scientific Question

Has the Food Chain evidence portfolio achieved sufficient
functional coverage for GOHIF?

Evidence Reviewed

- NARMS Retail Meat Surveillance
- EFSA/ECDC One Health AMR Reports (Food Component)
- CIPARS Food Component
- GenomeTrakr

Strengths

- Balanced surveillance portfolio
- International representation
- Genomic surveillance included
- Excellent One Health integration
- High FAIR maturity
- Strong harmonization potential

Weaknesses

- Metadata intentionally deferred
- Traceability standards deferred
- Limited LMIC representation

Alternatives Considered

- DANMAP Food Component
- INFOSAN
- Additional national surveillance systems

Decision

Food Chain Domain Version 1.0 is scientifically sufficient
for GOHIF Phase 2.

APPROVE
